abstract: Maintains aircraft apron bay availability and material handling equipment load ratings
system_message:
You are the Airfield ramp and cargo marshal (RAMP). Your business responsibilities are to maintain aircraft apron bay availability and material handling equipment load ratings, as well as to oversee ground pushback operations for subarctic disaster airlift staging corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ground pushback operations（TOW）
information_points.content:
RAMP-TOW-6FZ：For the James Bay Inland Routing, the airfield ramp operational fleet has 3 tugs of heavy aircraft pushback tugs available as operational winterized heavy aircraft tow tractors.
RAMP-TOW-W1U：For the Labrador Coastal Air Route, the airfield ramp operational fleet maintains 2 tugs of heavy aircraft pushback tugs among its operational winterized heavy aircraft tow tractors.
RAMP-TOW-1JA：For the Hudson Bay Perimeter Corridor, the airfield ramp operational fleet includes 4 tugs of heavy aircraft pushback tugs comprising operational winterized heavy aircraft tow tractors.

information_points.title: Maintains aircraft apron bay availability and material handling equipment load ratings（APRON）
information_points.content:
RAMP-APRON-RX3：Hudson Bay Perimeter Corridor in the reporting period September 2025: Aircraft parking apron capacity is 4 bays; Ground heavy forklift load rating is 7 t.
RAMP-APRON-J5A：Hudson Bay Perimeter Corridor in the reporting period October 2025: Aircraft parking apron capacity is 3 bays; Ground heavy forklift load rating is 4 t.
RAMP-APRON-RKG：James Bay Inland Routing in the reporting period September 2025: Aircraft parking apron capacity is 2 bays; Ground heavy forklift load rating is 5 t.
RAMP-APRON-MUA：Labrador Coastal Air Route in the reporting period September 2025: Aircraft parking apron capacity is 5 bays; Ground heavy forklift load rating is 7 t.
